summary: Review file-upload surfaces for trust boundaries, storage naming, parser isolation, size/resource limits and authorization of read/write paths.

must_inspect.why: User-controlled names or keys must not escape the intended storage namespace or overwrite unrelated objects.
false_positive_guards: Do not infer path traversal when object storage keys are not filesystem paths.

must_inspect.why: Content type, extension and parser choice are untrusted-input decisions with different failure modes.
false_positive_guards: Do not demand deep content inspection if the system deliberately stores opaque blobs and never parses them.

must_inspect.why: Upload/download limits and authorization should preserve availability and tenant/object access boundaries.
false_positive_guards: Do not infer public exposure from signed URLs without checking expiry/scope.
Do not include malicious payload recipes in findings.
handoff_triggers: Active exploit testing -> dedicated security workflow
